instruction: Implement slugs.unique_slug(label, taken). label is a string and taken is a list of existing exact-case slug strings. Lowercase ASCII A-Z, replace each maximal run outside a-z and 0-9 with one hyphen, and trim leading/trailing hyphens. Do not transliterate non-ASCII characters. If nothing remains use item. If the result is taken, try base-2, base-3, and so on until the first unused value; gaps must be reused. Preserve taken and its order. Standard library only.
